description: Returns scored public-records leads for a state, optional city, and lead type from a cached snapshot (estate- or heir-named owners and HUD REO, plus tax-lien flags when present). Included with Lead Alerts ($49/month, one state) and Pro ($149/month). No per-call charge; send header X-Property-Plan-Key.

area.description: Optional city or county name to filter the list.

lead_type.description: Lead type. Types not in the cache return an empty list with a coverage note.

state.description: USPS two-letter code, DC, or PR.

name: property_leads
title: Property Leads
